Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Darbhanga College of Engineering, Darbhanga Mabbi Lalsahpur Darbhanga PIN-846005 . 3. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 4. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The Bidder/OEM should have 3 years of experience in the manufacturing of such equipment in their m anufacturing facility. 2. The bidder/OEM should not have been blacklisted/debarred by any State Government / central Govern ment institution/department for any reason. An affidavit in this regards on Stamp paper should be sub mitted by bidder/OEM.

3. Copies of acknowledgement of GST returns of the latest quarter of the current Financial Year are to be submitted. 4. EMD in favour of The Principal, Darbhanga College of Engineering College, Darbhanga should be submi tted Before Bid Opening. 5. Bidders/OEM must produce a work order for a minimum amount of 50 Lacs, of which 80% payment mu st be received. 6. Bidders/OEM must provide the details (name of OEM make and Model Number) of all the equipment to be supplied by them. The Bidder/OEM are also required to submit the OEM’s product catalogue/brochu re indicating the specifications of offered equipment for technical suitability. 7. OEM should have its own manufacturing facility & should enclose original photos, Image of the manufa cturing plant as a proof of OEM. 8. Bidders/OEM must have a Solvency Certificate of amount 80% of bid value issued by Nationalize/Scheduled Bank. The same should be submitted along with bid. The issue date should not be 6 months old from the date of last day of submission of bid. 9. Copies of acknowledgement of income tax returns for the last three financial Years are to be submitted . 10. Sample product/ online product tutorial of product can be demanded from any bidder during technical evaluation to ascertain quality & specification as per discretionary of buyer. Bidder has to provide sam ple within 10 days or online product during 2 days of demand otherwise bid may be rejected 11. The OEM must submit MSME & NSIC certificate, if applicable. 12. Factory license of OEM, process of manufacturing in the factory and list of plant &machinery should be submitted by the bidder. 13. Payment will be released only after satisfactory delivery, installation, demonstration and acceptance o f goods at our institute. 14. All bid submitted shall also include the following information or documents in technical bid. I. Bidder must submit the copy of PAN card. II. The bidder must submit the copy of GST registration certificate from the competent authority. 15. The bidder/OEM average annual turnover in India should be at least 10 crore (Ten Crore) fo r the last three financial year. The same should be supported by balance sheet audited by CA. 16. Bidder/OEM must have active service support and required to furnish contact details of service execu tive, details to be furnished on bidder letter head. 17. Bidder must submit valid ISO 9001, ISO 45001and ISO 14001 certificate of OEM. 18. OEM must have NABL calibration facilities on own or through its sister concern. Documents in support should be submitted with bid. 19. Bidder who do not meet the criteria above are subjected to be disqualified if they have made untrue o r false representation in form, statement and attachment submitted in proof of the qualification requir ement or have a record of poor performance , not properly completing the contract, inordinate delay i n completion or financial failure , any false declaration etc. 20. All products should carry a three year onsite warranty. 21. Details of comprehensive annual maintenance contract (CAMC) after the warranty period may be clear ly mentioned in the financial bid documents (as applicable). 22. The prices must be inclusive of GST, freight, packing, unloading, installation & foundation etc. 23. Principal, Darbhanga College of Engineering College, Darbhanga reserves the right to canc el the bid at any time without assigning any reason thereof. 24. Bidder must provide the hard copies of detail manual /brochure with each item/equipment.
25. In case of any conflict in terms and conditions, the ATC will be accepted. .
